title: Reinforced Furnace
keywords: Electric furnace using current furnace-smelting recipes, not fuel burn time as its FE cost

blocks.text: Electric furnace using current furnace-smelting recipes, not fuel burn time as its FE cost. It retains returned containers and completed outputs.

rows: Place a smeltable item in the input.
Provide enough FE for the configured furnace batch.
Leave room for the output and any crafting remainder.

blocks.text: The furnace’s process cost/time are machine settings; they are not the same as an ingredient’s furnace fuel value.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
